title: External-visible probe responses expose no internal identifier or operational value
asA: operator whose probe surface is reachable by anyone who resolves the traffic host
iWant: the probe response to carry no dependency name, environment, hostname, replica id, build hash, or metric
soThat: the surface never fingerprints the service to a reader who was not meant to inspect the internal shape

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Kubernetes profile's `/live` and `/ready` responses contain no substring matching a declared dependency name, environment name, hostname, replica identifier, build hash, or commit sha.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the Kubernetes profile with declared dependencies `paymentsProvider` and `primaryStore`, environment `live`, hostname `svc-abc-123`, build hash `deadbeef`, commit sha `abcd1234abcd1234abcd1234abcd12341234abcd`
acceptanceCriteria.when: an HTTP GET is issued against `/live` and against `/ready` and each response body is scanned for the tokens above
acceptanceCriteria.then: no scan finds any of the tokens on either response body

acceptanceCriteria.description: The profile validator refuses a profile override that adds a field beyond the enumerated response contract at boot.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a profile configuration that adds a `dependencies` array to the Kubernetes profile's response body
acceptanceCriteria.when: the profile validator runs at boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process exits with a non-zero code and emits a `PROBE_RESPONSE_FIELD_REFUSED` error naming the offending field and the profile name

acceptanceCriteria.description: The load-balancer and reverse-proxy profile responses contain content-length zero on every request.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the `loadBalancer` profile and a second process on the `reverseProxy` profile, both booted normally
acceptanceCriteria.when: HTTP GET requests are issued against the resolved health path on each process for both pass and fail states
acceptanceCriteria.then: every response carries `Content-Length: 0` and the response body is empty
